overview.description: The MicroSectors 3x Long Artificial Intelligence (AI) ETNs (AIQU) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the BITA AI Leaders Select index. The fund is an exchange-traded note that seeks to provide 3x the daily performance of an index of US-listed companies involved in artificial intelligence technologies. The note is designed as a short-term trading tool and resets its leveraged exposure daily. AIQU was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by REX Microsectors.
